@graph.howPerformed: Depending on the chosen procedure, treatment sessions are spread over a few weeks for the best results. You'll receive detailed aftercare instructions to support healing, and our dermatologists take every precaution to minimize risks.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the type and severity of your scars. Most patients need 3–6 sessions, and our dermatologist will create a customized plan for you.
Some procedures, such as laser therapy, may cause mild discomfort. Numbing cream is applied beforehand, and any discomfort afterwards is usually easy to manage.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results typically begin to appear after 2–3 sessions and continue to improve over time as new collagen forms.
Treatment can significantly reduce the appearance of scars, but complete removal isn't always possible, especially for deep scars. Texture and tone can still improve greatly.
